routers.title: Home
routers.description: Smart home status and controls. Writes ask for approval.

tools.name: get_live_context
tools.title: Get live context
tools.description: Get the live state of every exposed device in the home, including lights, sensors, and locks.

tools.name: delete_scene
tools.title: Delete scene
tools.description: Delete a saved scene by ID. The scene cannot be restored after it is deleted from the hub.

tools.name: unlock_door
tools.title: Unlock door
tools.description: Unlock a door lock by entity ID and return the new lock state reported by the device.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: Read-only list of every device in the home with its name, room, and current state.
